title: Cliamp: a Winamp 2 clone built for your terminal

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Feeling nostalgic for the late '9s? Meet Cleamp. A Win Amp 2 clone built for your terminal. It plays almost every audio format with a live 10B spectrum visualizer and full playlist management. Stream internet radio via M3U, listen to podcasts, or connect directly to your self-hosted Navadrome server. If you want to listen to music while coding without ever leaving your terminal and you miss the golden age of desktop media players,
